ambient_events: The chemical rime crunches like frost and leaves a pale burn where it touches skin.
At the flat's edge the ground simply stops mattering, grey into grey into nothing.
description: The southwestern corner of the walkable world, a flat where a pale chemical rime crusts the ground like frost that never melts. It marks the edge; beyond it the map, and the wastes, and the will to go on, all give out.
name: Rime Flat
